"Time" is a song by the English rock band Pink Floyd.
It is included as the fourth track on their eighth album The Dark Side of the Moon (1973) and was released as a single in the United States.

With lyrics written by bassist Roger Waters, guitarist David Gilmour shares lead vocals with keyboardist Richard Wright  (his last until "Wearing the Inside Out" on the band's 1994 album The Division Bell).
